context.en: A nineteenth-century portrayal of Qin Shi Huang, who approved Li Si’s proposal.
context.zh: 十九世纪描绘的秦始皇，他批准了李斯的建议。

context.en: Li Jing appears on the left of this later portrait album; Du Ruhui is on the right.
context.zh: 这幅后世人物册页左侧为李靖，右侧为杜如晦。

context.en: A Ming commemorative portrait of Yue Fei, dressed according to Ming rather than Southern Song conventions.
context.zh: 明代纪念岳飞的画像，衣冠采用明制，而非南宋服饰。

context.en: A Qing portrait identifies Xie Xuan by his posthumous title, Duke Xianwu of Kangle.
context.zh: 清代画像以“康乐献武公”的封爵、谥号标明谢玄身份。
